'''Andreas De Leenheer''' (16 May 1941 – 20 November 2022) was a Belgian academic and biologist. He was Vice-Rector of [[Ghent University]] from 1997 to 2001 and Rector from 2001 to 2005.

==Biography==
In 1971, De Leenheer became a lecturer at the Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences at Ghent University. In 1977, he became a full professor and headed the laboratories department at the Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences from 1984 to 1993. He was dean of the Faculty from 1984 to 1992. From 1992 to 1998, he was chair of the Department of Bioanalysis. From 1997 to 2001, he was Vice-Rector before serving as Rector from 2001 to 2005. During his tenure, he led the movement for the renovation of the [[Boekentoren]], convincing the university board to provide funds for the project in 2005.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ugentmemorialis.be/catalog/000003910|title=De Leenheer, André 1941-|work=Ghent University|language=Dutch}}</ref>

In honor of his daughter, Marianne, who died in a traffic collision in 1991, De Leenheer created the Marianne De Leenheerprijs in 2008, a prize of 2500 euros per year for mathematics students at Ghent University.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=4 July 2008|title=Gentse oud-rector herdenkt verongelukte dochter met prijs|trans-title= |url=https://www.nieuwsblad.be/cnt/g9h1ttuo8|language=Dutch|work=[[Het Nieuwsblad]]|location= |access-date=22 November 2022}}</ref>

De Leenheer served as chairman of the [[Film Fest Ghent]] until 2014, when he was succeeded by {{ill|Claire Tillekaerts|nl}}.<ref>{{cite news |last=Degrande|first=Magali|date=3 April 2014|title=Film Fest Gent krijgt nieuwe Raad van Bestuur|trans-title= |url=https://www.nieuwsblad.be/cnt/blmde_20140403_005|language=German|work=Het Nieuwsblad|location= |access-date=22 November 2022}}</ref> He also served as director of the {{ill|Gent Festival van Vlaanderen|nl}} and chairman of the [[Federal Public Planning Service Science Policy]]. In 2008, [[Monarchy of Belgium|King]] [[Albert II of Belgium]] made him a [[Baron]].

De Leenheer died in [[Ghent]] on 20 November 2022, at the age of 81.<ref>{{cite news |last=Staes|first=Bert|date=22 November 2022|title=Oud-rector Andreas De Leenheer (81) overleden: "Je was een groot mens en rector, André"|trans-title= |url=https://www.nieuwsblad.be/cnt/dmf20221121_96725764|language=Dutch|work=Het Nieuwsblad|location=Ghent|access-date=22 November 2022}}</ref>
